Experience.title: Experience
Experience.subtitle: Six years shipping web and mobile products across fintech, Web3 and e-commerce.

achievements: Architected a modular, feature-based frontend for an e-wallet platform, accelerating feature delivery by 25% and reducing technical debt.
Created a unified React and React Native component library used across core multi-platform workflows.
Integrated secure REST APIs for authentication, payment processing and real-time state synchronization.
Designed and executed automated unit and functional tests covering 20+ core user paths, reducing production regressions.
Introduced an AI harnessing system (agents, constraints and sub-agents) that automates repetitive development workflows.
Mentored junior engineers and led technical code reviews, raising code quality and delivery efficiency.
Built performant React components optimized for low-latency access, improving responsiveness and user retention.
Created 6+ reusable UI components integrated with custom Node.js and Express REST APIs, cutting feature development time by 30%.
Extended custom SAP functionality and enterprise business integrations.
Engineered CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions, eliminating manual deployment errors.
Authored core architecture documentation and mentored developers in an Agile team.
Delivered multi-language support (i18n) and responsive, accessible React and React Native Web interfaces.
Shipped 3 major Web3 features on time, integrating the UI with RESTful backend microservices.
Orchestrated automated cloud deployments on Vercel and Railway, sustaining 99.9% uptime.
Delivered 5+ custom web and mobile products from requirement analysis to deployment.
Designed full-stack workflows, RESTful API architectures and SAP ecosystem integrations.
Modeled databases and implemented authentication and authorization services (JWT/OAuth).
Standardized architecture with SOLID and Clean Code practices across client projects.

CaseStudies.title: Three projects, measured by their outcome
CaseStudies.subtitle: Three projects where a specific change produced a number I can defend.

beland.situation: Beland was building an e-wallet that had to ship the same core flows on web and mobile, while the codebase was growing faster than the team.
beland.task: Own the frontend and mobile architecture, create a shared UI foundation, and integrate authentication, payments and real-time state without slowing delivery.
beland.action: Designed a modular, feature-based architecture; built one React and React Native component library; integrated secure REST APIs; covered 20+ core paths with automated tests; introduced an AI harnessing workflow with agents, constraints and sub-agents; mentored juniors and led reviews.
beland.result: Feature delivery became 25% faster, technical debt and production regressions dropped, and onboarding new engineers became a repeatable process.

awaq.situation: AWAQ's platform had to stay fast for low-latency users while extending SAP integrations, and every release depended on manual deployment steps.
awaq.task: Improve responsiveness and retention, build reusable UI connected to Node and Express services, and remove manual release work.
awaq.action: Built performant React components; shipped 6+ reusable UI components integrated with custom APIs; extended SAP functionality; automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions; documented the architecture and mentored the team.
awaq.result: Feature development time fell by 30%, manual deployment errors disappeared, and cross-system operations kept running without interruptions.
awaq.note: AWAQ worked on the Somos Awaq and ACI platforms.

happ3n.situation: Happ3n was taking a Web3 events platform to international users while three major features had fixed deadlines.
happ3n.task: Deliver multilingual, accessible, responsive interfaces and connect them to REST microservices without compromising uptime.
happ3n.action: Implemented i18n and accessible React and React Native Web UI; integrated the frontend with RESTful microservices; orchestrated automated cloud deployments on Vercel and Railway.
happ3n.result: All three features shipped on time, deployments held 99.9% uptime, and the platform reached new international audiences.

Projects.PhotoPuzzle: A mobile puzzle game where players build puzzles from their own photos or play curated ones, track their best times and share wins.
Projects.RNFactory: A React Native and Expo app factory that speeds up mobile bootstrapping with AI harnessing, shared monorepo architecture and built-in monetization.
Projects.LobaCounter: A mobile scorekeeper for the traditional card game “La Loba”, with real-time rounds, player management and no manual notes. Published on Google Play with EAS.
Projects.BelandApp: A mobile app for Beland, a Web3 company building its own eco cryptocurrency, where users can participate and acquire entries and related products.
Projects.Awaq: A web platform for the NGO Somos Awaq, focused on environmental protection and social development, with project, event and donation management.
Projects.SurveyApp: A PWA for iOS, Android and Windows used by political pollsters, with a mobile-first interface, dynamic charts and automatic progress analytics.
Projects.Milagros Cosmetic: An e-commerce site with products, blog and courses for a cosmetic dermatology practice, built with SEO and search-friendly content.
Projects.Gilson Regalos: A toy store storefront with promotions, articles, an about page and a WhatsApp contact CTA, plus automated SEO and a dynamic catalog.
Projects.Node Ready: A Node.js and Express backend starter with JWT auth, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, full API documentation in Swagger and a deploy-ready structure.
Projects.NearVet: A veterinary clinic app with CRUD for users, pets, veterinarians, appointments and medical records, payment integration and a Render-hosted database.
Projects.ShopAll: An e-commerce template for phones, tablets and computers, with detailed product pages and prices served from PostgreSQL.
Projects.Leyria & De Menezes: A law firm website with news, certifications and online appointment booking, designed to be reused by other practices.
Projects.ShowFilms: A movie explorer with descriptions, cast, directors and ratings, built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript plus MongoDB to show framework-free fundamentals.
Projects.Sumario Legal API: A legal-text API that transforms structured case data into standardized Word documents, using Gemini to draft summaries for court rulings.
